summary.zh-CN: PostHog 官方远程 MCP，通过 Personal API Key 以只读方式运行已保存的洞察查询、查看项目与事件及属性结构。连接设置以官方参数只开放只读会话与三项工具，经单一 exec 工具调用。数据经由 posthog.com 传输。
summary.en: PostHog official remote MCP: with a personal API key, read-only access to run saved insight queries, view projects, and explore events and properties. The connection settings use official parameters to open a read-only session limited to three tools, called through a single exec tool. Data transits posthog.com.

label.zh-CN: PostHog Personal API Key（在账户设置中以 MCP Server 预设生成）
label.en: PostHog personal API key (create it with the MCP Server preset in account settings)

description.zh-CN: 在只读会话中执行 PostHog 命令（仅限 insight-query、projects-get、read-data-schema）
description.en: Run PostHog commands in a read-only session (insight-query, projects-get, read-data-schema only)

conditions.zh-CN: 连接设置带 readonly=true 与 tools= 白名单（官方参数）；只读由服务端保证，密钥本身权限取决于创建时的预设
conditions.en: The connection settings set readonly=true and a tools= allowlist (official parameters); read-only is enforced server-side and the key keeps whatever its preset grants

conditions.zh-CN: 非 Cursor 客户端由服务端给出单一 exec 工具；以 tools 模式运行时服务端说明超过 Teloa 的 4KB 上限会被拒连，故不用该模式
conditions.en: For clients other than Cursor the server exposes a single exec tool; tools mode sends server instructions beyond Teloa's 4KB limit and would be refused, so it is not used

conditions.zh-CN: 数据经由 posthog.com 平台传输
